steps.message:
This is a one-line edit, but it's a session lifetime change, so I want a yes before touching it.

`config.js:3` sets `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30`, and `server.js` expires sessions off that value. Going to 480 means a stolen or abandoned session stays valid for a full working day instead of half an hour — an unattended browser, a shared machine, or a leaked session token all keep access 16× longer. There's no idle-timeout or re-auth path in this code to soften that; the value is the whole control.

If that's the intent, say so and I'll make the change.
